# VideoNook

> Video podcast and content studio in Armstrong, BC, Canada. Done-for-you weekly video reels and video podcast recording for business owners in the North Okanagan and Shuswap (Armstrong, Vernon, Salmon Arm, and surrounding communities).

VideoNook is a Rhythm Productions studio. Contact: info@rhythmproductions.ca. Website: https://videonook.ca

## Services and pricing

- We record your reels: $297/month founding price, regular rate $397/month. The founding price covers the first 10 spots and is locked in for the rest of this year. Done-for-you weekly video reels: 4 reels delivered monthly, a plan built around what your customers need to hear, scripting, monthly one-hour studio session, a half hour of strategy after every shoot, on-camera coaching, teleprompter available, editing, captions, post copy, and one round of revisions included. Monthly billing, three-month minimum, cancel anytime after.
- Record your video podcast: $497/session. Up to 90 minutes in studio, up to 60 minutes recorded, two people. One horizontal 1080p video auto-cut live between 2 camera angles, audio baked in, plus a separate audio track for podcast platforms. Retakes cut, no full edit. Files delivered same day, when you leave. Extras: extra person +$50/seat (third seat with an additional camera, up to 3 cameras total), raw files +$97 (delivered in 48 business hours), 4K upgrade +$147 (raw files included, delivered in 48 business hours).
- Podcast audio only session: $297/session. Up to 90 minutes in studio, up to 60 minutes recorded, two people. Mixed audio file in hand on leaving. Retakes cut, no full edit.
- Produced podcast episodes: starting at $997, includes the studio session. Multicam edit, mixed audio, titles, photos or footage cut in. One round of revisions. Quoted once the scope is known.
- Legacy video session (family stories, recorded in studio): $497. A 45-minute conversation with two cameras, cutting between the two of you as you talk, with the sound recorded properly.
- Legacy audio only session: $197. A 45-minute conversation, voices only, no cameras in the room. The easiest place to start if they would be more comfortable without a camera.
- Produced legacy film: starting at $997, includes the session. Old photos, home movies, letters and slides worked in around the conversation with music underneath. Quoted once I see what you have.

## Key facts

- Studio location: Armstrong, BC, right across from Askew's (plenty of parking, easy highway access)
- Session hours: 9am to 5pm, Monday through Friday, by appointment only
- Service area: North Okanagan and Shuswap, including Vernon, Salmon Arm, and Armstrong
- All equipment included: cameras, mics, lighting, and an engineer
- Podcast recordings use two camera angles with engineered audio
